privileged_info_for_vlm: The National Hurricane Center (Miami_NHC) is located at approximately 25.7543 N, 80.3800 W at 2-3m altitude. The required satellites and their NORAD IDs are: NOAA 15 (25338), NOAA 18 (28654), and NOAA 19 (33591). Ensure the 'Global_Wx' module is Map-only, 'Radar_Wx' is Polar-only, and 'Schedule_Wx' is List-only.
